endpoints.rationale: Authority cancellation is revocation on the connection.
endpoints.review_note: revoke (affa_client.py:408-447) is the fail-closed cancellation: it sets _revoked/_starts_closed, latches cancel and SIGKILLs the authority child. The protocol-level cancel is RunBroker.cancel issuing K.CANCEL (run_broker.py:888-903, native reason 5/6) with revoke as fallback (905-918); ReleaseOwner.cancel only cascades (owner.py:761-769).

endpoints.rationale: Ticket consumption happens at the owner's Release; replayed tickets are fenced (REJECTED reason 4).

endpoints.rationale: Independent review: The claim that no lock symbol exists is not supported by the code. A nonblocking mutation lock set exists: FiniteDispatcher.run acquires self._lock, facade._lock and owner._lock with acquire(False) and raises ML-SCHEDULE-CONFLICT (dispatcher.py:1205-1215); ReverseTeardown._mutation_locks names the same set plus the broker lock (teardown.py:308-311) and is acquired nonblocking in run/phase (354-357, 486-489); ReleaseOwner, RunBroker and ProcessReadiness use the same pattern (owner.py:775, 834; run_broker.py:523; providers.py:377). CancellationLatch is documented as independent of that lock (supervisor.py:52), which is exactly ML-SR-011. Propose binding to FiniteDispatcher.run as the coordinator acquisition site, citing ReverseTeardown._mutation_locks as the symbol enumerating the lock set.
